moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Dragon Darts
moves.description:
Dragon (Physical)
Base Power: 50
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit. In Double Battles, this move attempts to hit the targeted Pokemon and its ally once each. If hitting one of these Pokemon would be prevented by immunity, protection, semi-invulnerability, an Ability, or accuracy, it attempts to hit the other Pokemon twice instead. If this move is redirected, it hits that target twice.

moves.name: Phantom Force
moves.description:
Ghost (Physical)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

Dragon (Special)

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.description:
Ghost (Special)
Base Power: 80
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Psychic Fangs
moves.description:
Psychic (Physical)
Base Power: 85
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated.

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.description:
Dark (Physical)
Base Power: 70
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 1
Fails if the target did not select a physical attack, special attack, or Me First for use this turn, or if the target moves before the user.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.description:
Bug (Physical)
Base Power: 70
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Light Clay
items.description: Holder's use of Aurora Veil, Light Screen, or Reflect lasts 8 turns instead of 5.

items.name: White Herb
items.description: Restores all lowered stat stages to 0 when one is less than 0. Single use.

items.name: Lum Berry
items.description: Holder cures itself if it has a non-volatile status or is confused. Single use.

items.name: Colbur Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Dark-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Choice Scarf
items.description: Holder's Speed is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

items.name: Wide Lens
items.description: The accuracy of attacks by the holder is 1.1x.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

abilities.name: Clear Body
abilities.description: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.description: This Pokemon's moves ignore substitutes and the opposing side's Reflect, Light Screen, Safeguard, Mist, and Aurora Veil.

abilities.name: Cursed Body
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is hit by an attack, there is a 30% chance that move gets disabled unless one of the attacker's moves is already disabled.
